faker.js and colors.js Maintainer Sabotage

Campaign: faker-colors-sabotage-2022
Date: 2022-01-04 to 2022-01-09 (5 days)
Actor: Author (maintainer)
Impact: service_disruption, data_destruction

Synopsis

The faker.js and colors.js sabotage was a paired maintainer protest that broke two widely used npm libraries in early January 2022. Instead of an outside intruder, the trusted author changed source and package releases in ways that disrupted dependent applications, test suites, and production startup paths. The campaign belongs together because the same maintainer, motive, ecosystem, and week exposed how social and economic strain can become supply-chain failure.
